spec.description: Microsoft Storage Spaces Direct — SM-SANHA01 / SM-SANHA02 / SM-SANHA03

spec.title: Physical Disk Avg Latency per Node

spec.query:
from(bucket:"s2d_sanha")
  |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement=="win_physicaldisk")
  |> filter(fn:(r) => r._field=="Avg._Disk_sec/Read" or r._field=="Avg._Disk_sec/Write")
  |> filter(fn:(r) => r.node =~ /${node:regex}/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every:v.windowPeriod, fn:mean, createEmpty:false)
  |> group(columns:["_time","node","_field"])
  |> mean()
  |> group(columns:["node","_field"])

from(bucket:"s2d_sanha")
  |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement=="win_physicaldisk")
  |> filter(fn:(r) => r._field=="Disk_Read_Bytes_persec" or r._field=="Disk_Write_Bytes_persec")
  |> filter(fn:(r) => r.node =~ /${node:regex}/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every:v.windowPeriod, fn:mean, createEmpty:false)
  |> group(columns:["_time","node","_field"])
  |> sum()
  |> group(columns:["node","_field"])

from(bucket:"s2d_sanha")
  |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement=="s2d_hybrid_disk")
  |> filter(fn:(r) => r._field=="Cache_Hit_Reads_persec" or r._field=="Cache_Miss_Reads_persec")
  |> filter(fn:(r) => r.node =~ /${node:regex}/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every:v.windowPeriod, fn:mean, createEmpty:false)

from(bucket:"s2d_sanha")
  |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement=="s2d_csv")
  |> filter(fn:(r) => r._field=="Reads_persec" or r._field=="Writes_persec")
  |> filter(fn:(r) => r.node =~ /${node:regex}/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every:v.windowPeriod, fn:mean, createEmpty:false)

from(bucket:"s2d_sanha")
  |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement=="s2d_csv")
  |> filter(fn:(r) => r._field=="Read_Latency" or r._field=="Write_Latency")
  |> filter(fn:(r) => r.node =~ /${node:regex}/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every:v.windowPeriod, fn:mean, createEmpty:false)

from(bucket:"s2d_sanha")
  |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement=="win_physicaldisk" and r._field=="Current_Disk_Queue_Length")
  |> filter(fn:(r) => r.node =~ /${node:regex}/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every:v.windowPeriod, fn:mean, createEmpty:false)
  |> group(columns:["_time","node"])
  |> sum()
  |> group(columns:["node"])

spec.title: Physical Disk IOPS per Node (sum all disks)

spec.query:
from(bucket:"s2d_sanha")
  |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement=="win_physicaldisk")
  |> filter(fn:(r) => r._field=="Disk_Reads_persec" or r._field=="Disk_Writes_persec")
  |> filter(fn:(r) => r.node =~ /${node:regex}/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every:v.windowPeriod, fn:mean, createEmpty:false)
  |> group(columns:["_time","node","_field"])
  |> sum()
  |> group(columns:["node","_field"])
